sloka: यावज् जीवति काकुत्स्थः पिता मे जगती पतिः ।शुश्रूषा क्रियताम् तावत् स हि धर्मः सनातनः ॥२-२४-१२॥
transliteration: yāvaj jīvati kākutsthaḥ pitā me jagatī patiḥ ।śuśrūṣā kriyatām tāvat sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥2-24-12॥

translations.english: For a woman, to desert her husband is a cruel act. You must not do that which is contemptible even to think.
